info.title: Last Light API
info.description: Lunar mission engineering simulations, recovery plans and private scenario history.

post.description:
Takes a set of user credentials and returns an access and refresh JSON web
token pair to prove the authentication of those credentials.

Takes a refresh type JSON web token and returns an access type JSON web
token if the refresh token is valid.

Simulate 1–168 continuous hourly intervals (duration_hours, default 24), including Sun/Earth azimuths and a 36-point horizon_profile. Seven-day clients send duration_hours=168. disaster_mode injects a manual solar-storm-v1 stress test and forces bounded Fix Plan with stricter reserves. Source mode is selected by the server. Optional throttling returns 429 with Retry-After.
Evaluate the scenario and search for a recovery plan. Forces auto_resolve=true. Transit and waiting survival are not modeled.

* `not_needed` - not_needed
* `disabled` - disabled
* `found` - found
* `not_found` - not_found
* `budget_exhausted` - budget_exhausted
* `incomplete` - incomplete

elevation_deg.description: LOLA horizon elevation above the local horizontal, including mast height and lunar curvature.

horizon_profile.description: Static 360-degree horizon at the landing site, sampled every 10 degrees. Individual hourly visibility uses exact target bearings.

date.description: UTC calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, years 1900 through 2100.

duration_hours.description: Continuous hourly simulation; use 168 for a seven-day mission. Defaults to 24 for existing API clients.

disaster_mode.description: Inject solar-storm-v1: blackout, permanent electrical panel damage and critical-load operation. Forces Fix Plan with stricter reserves; not an observed event.

worst_case_override.description: Alias for disaster_mode. Conflicting explicit values are rejected.
